entities.name: Filip Mešár
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Filip Mešár is a Slovak professional ice hockey player who is a forward for the Laval Rocket of the American Hockey League (AHL) while under contract to the Montreal Canadiens of the National Hockey League (NHL). He was selected in the first round, 26th overall, by the Canadiens in the 2022 NHL entry draft.
